Name: Karry Wang

Description:
[size=4][b]Description[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]Meet Karry Wang, a gentle musician escaping busy city life to seek music inspiration by Pelican Town beach.
He loves playing guitar, raising chicks and listening to ocean waves. This fully custom marriageable male NPC includes unique seasonal portraits, exclusive cottage indoor map, custom guitar background music, complete heart events from 2-heart to 10-heart, theater dates, seaside proposal and rich post-marriage daily interactions.[/color]

[size=4][b]Installation instructions[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]1. Install SMAPI first to run mod files.
2. Download all required prerequisite mods and unzip them into your Stardew Valley Mods folder.
3. Unzip [CP]Karry_Wang and put the whole folder directly into Mods folder.
4. Launch the game through SMAPI executable to load the mod normally.[/color]

[size=4][b]Main features[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• Fully voiced unique dialogue for all seasons, festivals and weathers
• Complete 2/4/6/8/10 heart cutscenes and marriage plot
• Custom seaside cottage interior with interactive guitar, usable bed and chairs
• Exclusive original guitar background audio
• Seasonal 128px high-definition character portraits
• Independent gift preference, daily schedule and festival behavior
• Rich spouse daily interactions after marriage, including adoption system[/color]

[size=4][b]Requirements[/b][/size]
[color=#D4D4D8]• SMAPI
• Content Patcher
• SpaceCore
• Portraiture [/color]
• PortraiturePlus
